name: Stitch & Stella
tagline: Handmade dog bandanas, stitched in Houston.
description: Stitch & Stella stitches made-to-order dog bandanas in Houston, Texas. The studio is named for Stella, a goldendoodle. Allie is a bernedoodle and Mack is a mini Australian shepherd. You choose the cloth and the stitching. Finished bandanas are handed off in the Heights (77008 and 77009) and Garden Oaks (77018).
care: Machine wash cold with similar colors.
Skip the dryer so the edge stitch stays even.
safety: Take a tie-on bandana off when you cannot see the dog, including crates, dog parks, and rough play.
A collar slide stays on the collar you already trust. It does not replace a collar or a harness.
If a tie knot can catch on a fence, a crate, or another dog, use the collar slide instead.
notIncluded: Payment is not taken on this website. The studio confirms the ticket by email before anything is owed.
There is no shop floor to walk into.
Handoffs are the Saturday Heights window and the Thursday Garden Oaks drop. Anywhere else is a question on the ticket, not a promise.
replyHours: Tuesday through Saturday. Saturday is the Heights handoff. Thursday evening is the Garden Oaks drop.
